title: Bumblebee KFC Pack
description: This pack replaces Minecraft's Tears music disc with the legendary Bumblebee KFC song. Add a dose of meme-powered chaos to your jukebox and surprise your friends every time the disc plays.
body:
Turn Minecraft's newest music disc into pure meme energy!

This resource pack/mod replaces the **Tears** music disc with the iconic **Bumblebee KFC song**. Pop the disc into a jukebox and enjoy a completely different listening experience that's guaranteed to catch your friends off guard.

**Features**
- Replaces the Tears music disc audio with the Bumblebee KFC song
- Works anywhere the Tears disc can be played
- Client-side only
- No gameplay changes
- Multiplayer friendly (other players need the pack/mod installed to hear the replacement)

Whether you're building a base, hanging out with friends, or just collecting music discs, this pack adds a hilarious twist to one of Minecraft's newest tracks.

**Disclaimer:** This project is a fan-made meme replacement and is not affiliated with Mojang or KFC.
